content_fixes.old: God didn't even hesitate. He just swallowed Israel whole. Went beast mode and crushed all of Judah's defenses, totally wrecking their king and leaders.
content_fixes.new: God didn't even hesitate. He just swallowed Israel whole, crushing all of Judah's defenses in his fury, totally wrecking their king and leaders.
content_fixes.reason: MSG 2:2; 'went beast mode' is flippant meme slang for God's judgment.

content_fixes.old: God literally became the enemy. He devoured Israel for dinner. Chewed up all their defenses and spit them out. Now Judah's just left crying and complaining.
content_fixes.new: God became the enemy. He devoured Israel, chewing up all their defenses. Now Judah's just left crying and complaining.
content_fixes.reason: MSG 2:5 'The Lord has become the enemy. He has devoured Israel.' 'For dinner/spit them out' is flippantly crude for God devouring his people.
